notes: ἀκροατήριον is headed on *hearing* under rule 66's generic-completion test; heading it on *place* remains defensible.
τε is emptied because the ASV writes only one conjunction for the τε … καί pair (rule 70), and the καί at s028 is emptied because the ASV recasts its clause as a prepositional phrase.
τοῖς follows its noun and the ASV writes no relative clause for it, so the determiner stands on ἀνδράσιν and the article is unrepresented (rules 23 and 31).
